Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: South
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/15/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 171 as introduced would amend the Alabama First-time and Second Chance Home Buyer Savings Account Act to 1) allow an individual tax filer an additional five years to claim a deduction on individual income taxes; and 2) extend the sunset provision of this act from March 28, 2023, currently, to December 31, 2028. Based on deductions claimed in tax year 2020, this bill would reduce income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $150,000 annually for each year this program is extended.
Additionally, this bill will further increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue to collect and provide additional information for the annual report.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 171 as passed the House of Representatives would amend the Alabama First-time and Second Chance Home Buyer Savings Account Act to: 1) allow an individual or joint tax filer an additional five years to claim a deduction on individual income taxes; and 2) extend the sunset provision establishing new accounts under this act from March 28, 2023, currently, to December 31, 2028. Based on deductions claimed in tax year 2020, this bill would reduce income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $150,000 annually for each year this program is extended.
Additionally, this bill will further increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue to collect and provide additional information for the annual report.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education
